overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to maintain minutes for many meetings, including all 2013 meetings, and ordered compliance, re-creation of minutes, and training.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Hanson Capital Improvement Committee failed to maintain minutes of its meetings, after minutes for many meetings, including all of 2013, could not be produced.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Re-create minutes for all meetings using any available materials, including personal notes or recordings, no later than 60 days from receipt of the letter.
Review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Guide, with all members certifying in writing within 30 days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
